vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: sql-generator
Version: 2.3.4

The skill bundle is a legitimate SQL generation utility that provides templates for DDL, queries, and mock data. The primary logic resides in `scripts/sql.sh`, which uses standard bash commands to output SQL strings based on user input without executing them or performing any network/file system operations.

llm.summary: The skill's files and runtime instructions are coherent with a SQL-generation utility and do not request unrelated credentials, installs, or system privileges.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (SQL generator, DDL, mock data, migration, explain/optimize) match the included script (scripts/sql.sh) and tips. Minor note: the bundle includes a Bash script that requires a POSIX shell environment (bash/tr/date/cat), but required binaries were declared as none — this is a small omission rather than a substantive mismatch.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs use of the provided sql.sh commands (query, explain, optimize, create, mock, migrate, cheatsheet). The instructions do not request reading unrelated system files, environment variables, or sending data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only) and the only code is a local shell script included in the skill. Nothing is downloaded at install time and no external package registries or URLs are used.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. The skill's functionality (SQL generation) does not appear to require secrets or external credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable; autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but is not combined with broad credentials or persistent privileged actions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and focused on generating SQL and related artifacts. Before running the script, inspect scripts/sql.sh fully (the provided excerpt is truncated) and confirm there are no unexpected network calls or shell operations you don't want to run. Because it is a shell script, run it in a safe/sandboxed environment if you plan to execute it locally (do not run unreviewed scripts as root). Also verify the author/homepage if you need provenance or licensing information.
